name: Earshot Acoustic & SFX Synthesis CLI
purpose: Acoustic intelligence CLI for objective audio measurements and procedural sound synthesis.
capabilities: True peak, integrated loudness, and spectral bandwidth measurement (earshot measure)
Sound design synthesis in code (earshot forge)

installation.instructions: Installed inside local .venv via pip install -e tools/earshot.

licensing.notes: Open-source MIT toolkit vendored under tools/earshot.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 4B foley and Stage 9 Gate 5 audit.
